candidates.explanation: When createUserDto.provider is not set, the default provider is AuthProvidersEnum.google instead of AuthProvidersEnum.email. AuthService.register doesn't pass a provider, so every email-registered user is saved with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then sees user.provider !== 'email' and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.

fix.description: Default the provider to email: `provider: createUserDto.provider ?? AuthProvidersEnum.email`.
